statements.impact_statement: MCP is present only as a transitive dependency of the Semgrep development scanner. Netra does not import or expose the deprecated MCP WebSocket server transport.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade Semgrep and MCP when Semgrep permits MCP 1.28.1 or newer; owner: Netra security maintainers.

statements.impact_statement: MCP is present only as a transitive dependency of the Semgrep development scanner. Netra does not run an MCP HTTP or SSE server and does not use MCP session authentication.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade Semgrep and MCP when Semgrep permits MCP 1.27.2 or newer; owner: Netra security maintainers.

statements.impact_statement: MCP is present only as a transitive dependency of the Semgrep development scanner. Netra never enables or executes MCP experimental task support.
statements.action_statement: Upgrade Semgrep and MCP when Semgrep permits MCP 1.27.2 or newer; owner: Netra security maintainers.
